name: Escape the Lava on Bike
desc:
The lava is rising… and your only chance is to RIDE!🔥🚴‍♂️

🚴‍♂️ Ride your bike and escape the rising lava to reach the finish and earn wins!
🔥 Train your bike speed and climb high obstacles before the lava catches you!
🏆 Collect pets to boost your speed and unlock new worlds with wins!

👍 Support us by Liking ⭐ and Favoriting ❤️ the game!
